tasks.label: investigate-posts-md-changes
args: git status --short; Write-Host '---'; $s = git status --short -- posts-md; if ($s) { $s | Measure-Object | ForEach-Object { "posts-md changed entries: $($_.Count)" }; $s | Select-Object -First 30 } else { 'posts-md changed entries: 0' }; Write-Host '---'; $tracked = git ls-files posts-md | Measure-Object; "posts-md tracked files: $($tracked.Count)"; $untracked = git ls-files --others --exclude-standard posts-md | Measure-Object; "posts-md untracked files: $($untracked.Count)"; Write-Host '--- most recent posts-md mtimes ---'; Get-ChildItem posts-md -File | Sort-Object LastWriteTime -Descending | Select-Object -First 15 Name,LastWriteTime | Format-Table -AutoSize

tasks.label: investigate-git-tracking
args: $postsStatus = git status --short -- posts-md; "posts-md changed lines: $(@($postsStatus).Count)"; $postsStatus | Select-Object -First 20; Write-Host '---'; $allTracked = git ls-files; "tracked files total: $(@($allTracked).Count)"; $trackedPosts = git ls-files posts-md; "tracked posts-md files: $(@($trackedPosts).Count)"; $untrackedPosts = git ls-files --others --exclude-standard posts-md; "untracked posts-md files: $(@($untrackedPosts).Count)"; $untrackedPosts | Select-Object -First 20

tasks.label: count-posts-and-untracked
args: Get-ChildItem posts-md -File | Measure-Object; git ls-files posts-md | Measure-Object; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard posts-md | Measure-Object; git status --short -- posts-md
